name: Quick test sub
function: A short section above the wireline valve with a test port that lets the stack above it be pressure tested from a test pump after a union is remade, without pressuring the well or the tree.

tabs.overview: The sub holds a test plug or seal so that test pressure is applied to the lubricator and head only; the rams below stay closed on the well. It removes the need to open the swab valve to test.
tabs.safety: Test pressure is bled through the test port, never by breaking a union.
tabs.evidence: Public pressure control equipment catalogs and service descriptions (S6, S7, S13); API RP 67 (S14) and API RP 19B (S15) for the perforating side; field practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test the stack before opening the swab valve; bleed to zero before breaking any union.
